title: Learning Multimodal Sensor Fusion with JEPA Representations for Breathing Activity and Pose Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.15891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predictive video representations do not by themselves specify how a multimodal system should handle missing sensors. We transfer frozen V-JEPA2 features to a set of heterogeneous sensors comprised by RGB video, depth video, and radar time series. A shared fusion model uses modality queries, fixed sensor slots, and explicit availability to classify breathing activity and pose from all seven non-empty sensor subsets. The contribution is a controlled evaluation of subset supervision, pooling capacity, and representation transfer on 39 OMuSense-23 subjects with five subject-group folds and three seeds. With matched downstream parameter counts, the final model reaches recording-level activity macro-F1 of $75.23%\pm0.60$ averaged across seven subsets. translated_title: 基于JEPA表征学习的多模态传感器融合用于呼吸活动与姿态识别
translated_abstract: 预测性视频表征本身并不能规定多模态系统应如何处理传感器缺失的情况。我们将冻结的V-JEPA2特征迁移到一组由RGB视频、深度视频和雷达时间序列组成的异构传感器上。一个共享的融合模型利用模态查询、固定传感器槽位和显式可用性标志，从全部七个非空传感器子集中对呼吸活动和姿态进行分类。本文的贡献在于对39名OMuSense-23受试者（采用五个受试者分组折交叉验证和三个随机种子）进行了子集监督、池化容量和表征迁移的受控评估。在下游参数量匹配的条件下，最终模型在七个子集上平均达到记录级活动宏F1为75.23%±0.60。在每批次中监督所有子集可相比匹配的查询池化对照组提升1.923个百分点（条件95%受试者自助置信区间[0.647, 3.209]），而查询池化显示……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将冻结的V-JEPA2视频表征迁移到融合RGB视频、深度视频和雷达的共享多模态模型中，通过模态查询机制与子集监督策略实现对传感器缺失鲁棒的呼吸活动与姿态识别，在全部七个传感器子集上平均达到75.23%的宏F1。
en_tdlr: This paper transfers frozen V-JEPA2 features to a shared multimodal fusion model over RGB, depth, and radar sensors, using modality queries and subset supervision for robust breathing activity and pose recognition under missing sensors, achieving 75.23% macro-F1 averaged across all seven sensor subsets.
